criterion: 99% empirical single-attempt stable-hover acquisition; no retries
limitations: Synthetic estimate, not a population guarantee. Front-facing planes; excludes neighboring control interception, live transport and headset comfort. 99% empirical is not a 99% lower confidence bound.

review.implementation: Expand dynamics menu 1.30x while a selected job is focused. Restore previous scale on job-list/back or another tab; preserve manual resize; clamp to existing menu limits.
review.recommendation: Retain requested 30% global expansion. For the strict highest-error target, reflow small controls: about 75 mm high at 200 mm width, or 100 mm square, at 300 mm ray distance. At 600 mm distance the estimates rise to 105 mm high or 131 mm square. Avoid making the entire panel 5x larger to compensate for the smallest button.
review.native_checks: Simulation panel lifecycle, idempotence, manual resizing, min/max clamps, ray routing and sidebar tests passed.
review.live_observation: Native scale changed .45 to .585 following steady_fast job click and synthetic metadata acknowledgment; isolated viewer without browser document, stopped after capture.
review.layout_limitations: Native selected-panel layout audit reports undersized controls and an existing ALL FRAMES / EVERY wheel hitbox overlap. Offline isolated-rectangle estimates exclude interception and are optimistic where controls overlap.
review.adjusted_visual_evidence: .development-artifacts/menu-scale-20261022-front2/{jobs,selected}/{left.png,right.png,mirror.png,evidence.json}; wrist orientation corrected from measured grip axes to face tracked eye; observation only, outside Monte Carlo study.
